partnershipPlan: The maternity voices partnership and two women who attended group care review the outcome definition and the plain-language summary.
socialListening: No social media listening; comment cards from the two group-care hubs are summarised.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I was nineteen and on my own; the group was the first place I did not feel judged.
Composite paraphrase: When the interpreter came every week I understood everything; the one week she did not, I stayed home.
items.implication: Cost interpreters as part of the intervention.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Two hours with ten women feels long, but I see each of them properly and they talk to each other.
items.implication: Measure midwife hours per woman, not per session.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Half our mothers would not come without the creche.
items.implication: Include childcare in costs and sensitivity analyses.

summary: Four composite voices on support, language, midwife time and childcare.
